description: Return verified credit-card product-change (downgrade) paths and the issuer's fee-refund window: which no-fee or lower-fee card a given card can be product-changed to, and how long after the annual fee posts a refund is available on cancellation. Optionally filtered to one card id (issuer:slug); returns every verified path and window when omitted.

cardId.description: Optional card id (issuer:slug), e.g. chase:sapphire-reserve or capital-one:venture-x-rewards. Omit to return every verified downgrade path and fee-refund window.

name: get_card_downgrade_path
